moments.author: Mike Evans
moments.quote: “I honestly didn't know it was him… 'Who are you?'… 'Oh, it's f—ing Diggs.'”
moments.why: A hilarious, meme‑worthy trash‑talk moment that exploded following the 49ers‑Seahawks game and landed Evans in meme of the week discussions.

moments.author: Richard Sherman
moments.quote: Mike Evans checking the name on the back of the jersey is an all‑time GIF and trash‑talk moment I wish I thought of.
moments.why: An ex‑Seahawks legend praising the moment helped fuel its viral spread among football fans.

moments.author: Joe Mixon
moments.why: His energetic comeback post upon joining the Seahawks caught immediate attention from NFL and fan circles.

moments.author: Joe Mixon
moments.quote: God will test your faith… Your breakthrough is coming.
moments.why: A heartfelt follow‑up to his return tweet that resonated emotionally with fans amid his year‑and‑a‑half journey.
